ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard shortcut 'n' does not open the header create menu on any page. Cause: the guard `document.querySelector(".MuiModal-root:not(.MuiModal-hidden), [role='dialog'], [role='alertdialog'], dialog[open]")` short-circuits because MUI keeps closed Dialogs mounted with a .MuiModal-hidden wrapper but the inner element still has role='dialog'. Right after login on /dashboard (The Dev Store) 5 such stale hidden dialogs are present (all inside .MuiModal-hidden, visibility:hidden), so the shortcut is dead 100% of the time.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Scope the dialog check to visible modals, e.g. `.MuiModal-root:not(.MuiModal-hidden) [role='dialog'], .MuiModal-root:not(.MuiModal-hidden), dialog[open]`, or filter matches by !el.closest('.MuiModal-hidden') && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden'.

rca of the issue: CreateNewButton.tsx registers a global keydown listener that bails out if `document.querySelector(".MuiModal-root:not(.MuiModal-hidden), [role='dialog'], [role='alertdialog'], dialog[open]")` returns any element. MUI keeps closed Dialogs mounted; the outer .MuiModal-root gets the MuiModal-hidden class, but the inner Paper/Content still carries role='dialog'. That comma-separated `[role='dialog']` branch is not scoped to visible ancestors, so any once-opened dialog leaves a permanent match and the shortcut is disabled. Mitigation: change the guard to select role='dialog' only under visible modals (e.g. `.MuiModal-root:not(.MuiModal-hidden) [role='dialog']`) OR filter matches by !el.closest('.MuiModal-hidden') and computed visibility !== 'hidden'.
